title: verify prints 'consistent, not anchored (no_anchor)' and 'last witnessed seq 0' on TAMPER/RECONCILE even with --head
outcome: the Audit beat's verify line matches C1 wording on failure
acceptance: With --head on a failing run: no 'consistent', unanchored_reason is not no_anchor, last_witnessed_seq real or omitted; demo-sim Audit TAMPER line equals real output; tests for TAMPER, WITNESS, RECONCILE with and without --head
summary: Round 2: failure line now 'last witnessed seq N (signed checkpoints)' or 'witness not checked (verify stopped at seq N)'; JSON last_witnessed_seq is the highest validly signed checkpoint (223 on TAMPER seq 100); README 1.8.0 has own C6 bullet; demo-sim updated; test asserts 20.
review:
[kabir · changes] Reviewed by kabir for panel (listed reviewer busy). CHANGES (small). Checked on a fresh container hero copy, every exit code, with/without --head, text + JSON: TAMPER(2) seq 100, WITNESS(3) truncation, RECONCILE(4) history edit, IO(1) missing config. All: no 'consistent', no 'no_anchor', unanchored_reason=verify_failed, '--head given' vs 'no --head' correct, exits correct; WITNESS/RECONCILE show real witnessed seq (218, 223). Blocking: (1) TAMPER at seq 100 prints 'no witnessed head reached' and JSON last_witnessed_seq 0, but the run has witnessed heads to seq 223; verify just stopped before the witness pass. Acceptance says 'real or omitted': 0 is neither, and the human text is a false statement on the finale Audit beat. Change the text to 'witness not checked (verify stopped at seq N)' (and IO: 'witness not checked'), and either make last_witnessed_seq nullable in 1.8.0 (null when not reached; same unreleased version, additive) or document 0 = not reached in rundir.py + README; fix demo-sim Audit line to match. (2) README 1.8.0 changelog: list verify_failed as its own C6 bullet (S4-32), not as a schema-regeneration footnote. VERSION DECISION: 1.8.0 carrying both S4-34 RevertEntry.to and verify_failed is acceptable: both additive, both unreleased; VerifyReport is verify output, never stored in a run dir, so 1.3-1.7 fixtures are unaffected (test_additive_13_run etc. pass in both suites). No 1.8.1 needed. Suites: native 1160 passed, container 1171 passed.

[kabir · done] DONE (reviewed by kabir for panel). Fresh container hero (killswitch:kabir, seed 2), every exit, with/without --head, text+JSON: TAMPER seq 100 -> exit 2, 'last witnessed seq 223 (signed checkpoints)', JSON last_witnessed_seq 223, unanchored_reason verify_failed; WITNESS truncation -> exit 3, 140; RECONCILE -> exit 4, 223; IO missing config -> exit 1, 'witness not checked (verify stopped)'. No 'consistent', no 'no_anchor' anywhere on failure. demo-sim Audit line matches real output. README 1.8.0 has its own C6 bullet. Nit (non-blocking): IO JSON gives last_witnessed_seq 0 while docs say '0 = none'; on IO it means 'not checked'. Make the doc say '0 = none or not reached' when next touched. Contracts 1.8.0 (S4-34 + verify_failed): 1.3-1.6 fixtures verify OK; this morning's 1.7.0 finale hero and F2+x verify OK anchored under the new code; test_contracts_13..18 + additive pass.
